projections.note: Every variable the summary flags fully. A sometimes-sensitive claim (KansligVariabelIbland 1, or a cell that is not 0 or 1) makes the variable sensitive whatever the plain claim says; a plain sensitive claim stays sensitive beside a conditional 0; only a plain 0 with a conditional 0 is built non-sensitive. sxc0 and nosum are absent: their sensitivity is unknown, and it is not defaulted to false. auth has no summary row either; its reviewed [[errata.flags]] entry states both flags (#1621).

Every issue of the build. The fully flagged variables raise none (the old ratchet tests' `result.diagnostics == ()`). A conditional 0 beside a blank plain cell supplies no sensitivity, so sxc0 is withheld for is_sensitive alone; nosum has no summary row and is withheld for both flags: its [[errata.flags]] entry pins another variable's originals, so it is stale (located below) and authors nothing. auth2 is withheld for both flags: AUTH's entry names column AUTH, and the partition gives the member's AUTH2 column to auth2, so the authored pair never reaches it (#1627); the derived same-definition pair between auth and auth2 is withheld with it.
The stale refusal prints NOSUM's own family digest (member 108), the pin a curator re-reviewing it would paste, as errata.delivered's does since #1558.
